settings.agentPolicy.protectState.label: Protect Tallpine state from agents
settings.agentPolicy.protectState.descri: Runs Claude Code agents' shell commands in Claude's sandbox and Kiro agents, and Codex and DeepSeek Harness agents in full-access (bypass) mode, in a macOS sandbox, and blocks them from reading Tallpine's install token, session key, database, GitHub token, app profile and mobile pairing keys. The tallpine CLI keeps working. Claude Code, Kiro, and full-access Codex and DeepSeek Harness on macOS only for now; Codex and DeepSeek Harness in their sandboxed modes, other agents and other systems run unchanged. While on, agent config committed to the repository (project .claude settings, hooks) does not load for Claude Code. File protection only, not data-loss prevention: network access is not restricted, so agents can still send what they can read anywhere. Off by default; a project can turn it on but not off.
settings.agentPolicy.protectState.on: On (Claude Code, Kiro, Codex and DeepSeek Harness full access; macOS)
settings.agentPolicy.protectState.creden: Hardened profile: paths hidden from agents in addition to ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, ~/.kube, ~/.config/gcloud, ~/.azure, ~/.docker/config.json, ~/.netrc, ~/.npmrc, ~/.pypirc and the gh and git credential stores. Absolute or ~/-relative, comma-separated.
Hardened profile: paths exempted from credential hiding. Prefer an SSH agent socket over allowing ~/.ssh.
settings.agentPolicy.protectState.devToo: Local dev tooling in the sandbox

When the sandbox is on: lets test servers, dev servers and the merge gate bind unix sockets under the session's own temp dir, and lets the Xcode tool shims (git, clang) write their xcrun_db cache files in the per-user temp dir. Those two are the only openings; Tallpine secrets stay hidden. Strict blocks it (tests that bind unix sockets then fail).
settings.agentPolicy.crossProjectOrchest: Orchestrator can coordinate with other projects

Lets this project's orchestrator list and message other projects' orchestrators (never their workers), register new projects, and configure and start the orchestrators of projects it created. Messages from other orchestrators reach the agent as untrusted data. Every action is audited. Off by default; an organization policy can force it off.
settings.agentPolicy.devMode.label: Unfenced development (Dev mode): orchestrators can do anything
settings.agentPolicy.devMode.description: WARNING: this is the policy switch, not General → Advanced → Developer mode. It lets every project's orchestrator do anything you can in Tallpine, including cross-project orchestrator start and config and any setting, and turns the protectState sandbox off for orchestrators (workers keep it). Workers stay limited to their own session. Only you can change this through the app, but an orchestrator can read the install token while Dev mode is on, so its access can outlast it: rotate the install token after turning Dev mode off. New sessions also start without the Security mode fence while it is on. Off by default; an organization policy can force it off.
settings.agentPolicy.orchestratorLanes.l: Main orchestrator can start and end lane orchestrators
settings.agentPolicy.orchestratorLanes.d: Lets this project's main orchestrator start a lane orchestrator for a top-level backlog item (with a first-message brief) and end it when the lane's items are done. A lane is never ended while one of its workers has an open PR, and lane orchestrators cannot start lanes. Off by default; an organization policy can force it off.

settings.reviewDefaults.terminateOnMerge: End workers when their PRs merge

On by default. A worker ends once its pull requests are merged or closed, none is open, it is idle and no message waits for it; the orchestrator gets an [auto] notice. Applies to workers started after you change it.

settings.security.mode.label: Security level
settings.security.mode.description: Choose how closely Tallpine fences your agents. One choice applies to the whole app.
settings.security.mode.standard.label: Standard
settings.security.mode.standard.line1: Agents run as they do today.
settings.security.mode.standard.line2: No extra fence around Tallpine's own files or your credentials.
settings.security.mode.protected.label: Protected
settings.security.mode.protected.line1: Agents are fenced off Tallpine's own files.
settings.security.mode.protected.line2: They only receive the environment variables they need, and GitHub tokens stay out of their environment.
settings.security.mode.unrestricted.line: Orchestrators can do anything you can in Tallpine.
New sessions start without the fence. Use only on a machine you are developing on.
settings.security.mode.unrestricted.conf: Unrestricted lets every project's orchestrator do anything you can in Tallpine, including starting and configuring other projects, and turns the fence off for orchestrators. Anything an orchestrator learns while this is on, such as the install token, can outlast it: rotate the install token after switching back. Running sessions keep their current setup until restarted.
settings.security.mode.conflict: Both Protected and Unrestricted are on in the settings. Unrestricted is in effect. Pick one to resolve this.
settings.security.orchestrators.title: What orchestrators may do
settings.security.orchestrators.unrestri: Unrestricted lets orchestrators do everything, so these are all allowed.
settings.security.load.title: What agents may load
settings.security.project.unrestricted: Unrestricted is on for the whole app and overrides this project's Security mode. The choice is kept and applies again when you leave Unrestricted.
settings.project.symlinksDescription: Repo-relative paths linked into every session workspace, one per line. Use it for large folders you do not want copied.
settings.project.cloneWorktreeIncludeDes: Seed folders listed in .worktreeinclude with a fast copy-on-write clone (macOS APFS only). Pair it with a setup command that reconciles the install.
settings.project.planningModeDescription: When the project plans before it builds. Automatic lets the orchestrator decide.
settings.project.verifyCommandDescriptio: A single command workers are told to run, and pass, before they push. Tallpine does not run it.
settings.project.agentRulesDescription: Standing instructions added to every worker session in this project.

settings.project.orchestratorRulesDescri: Standing instructions added to every orchestrator session in this project.
settings.project.autoReviewMaxRoundsDesc: Stop reviewing a PR automatically after this many reviews that asked for changes, and tell the orchestrator. 0 never stops.
